ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 。_ day of Qqobr_, 2005 by and between 233 EAST 34 ST.LLC, having an office at 233 East 34 Street, New York, New York 10016 ("Owner") and 225 EAST 34" STREET LLC, having an office c/o LCOR, Incorporated, One Penn Plaza, Suite 3310, New York, New York 10119 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is thefee owner of a certain parcel of land,together with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork, known as Lot 21 in Block 915 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner's Land"; the building and improvements thereon together with any future additions, alterations or replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, the “Owner's Building"; and the Owner's Land and the Owner's Building, collectively, the “Owner's Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, together with the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork, known as Lot 19 in Block 915 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and by the street address 225 East 34"h Street, New York, New York and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer's Land"; the building and improvements thereon together with any future additions, alterations Or replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, the “Developer's Building"; and the Developer's Land and the Developer's Building, collectively, the "Developer'sPremises"); WHEREAS, by Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated as of March 31, 2005, Developer has previously combined Developer's Premises and the land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 20 in Block 915 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and by the street address 231 East 34h Street, New York, WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct on Developer's Land a new building, (the new building and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations or replacements thereof permitted to the provisions of this Agreement, the“New Building"; WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on the Existing Zoning Lot and the NY2:11555440103IXC6_031.DOC57508.0003 1

parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Existing Zoning Lot with Owner's Premises so as to create a new larger, combined zoning lot (the “Merged Zoning Lot") to make available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction of theNewBuilding; WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in order to create the Merged Zoning Lot; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of themutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: Section 1. Definitions. (a) “Business Day” shall mean any day other than Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks are authorized to be closed in NewYork State. (b) “Development Rights"” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting or adding thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum floor area ratio established for structures in the zoning district or districts in which the zoning lot is located, (i) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, Section 23-90 et seq., Sections 81-63 et seq., 81-212, 81-254, 81-266, 81-277 and Section 74-79 et seq. thereof, and (i) the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York from time to time. (c)“Excess Development Rights"” shall mean shall mean that portion of the total of the Development Rights now or hereafter appurtenant to the Seller Parcel in excess of the Rights comprise 17,119.69 square feet of Development Rights. (d)“Lot 20 Retained Development Rights" shall mean the Development Rights appurtenant to the Lot 20 Premises which are utilized by the buildings and improvements situated on the Lot 20 Premises as of the date hereof plus 200 additional square feet of Development Rights appurtenant to the Lot 20Premises.
